name: Reporters
description:
Two ambitious journalists, Kabir and Ananya, work together at the KKN channel and eventually fall in love. However, when people plot to separate them, they have to overcome obstacles to stay together.

It is the story of two people finding love in a complex and cut throat world of journalism … where there is no right or wrong way of looking at news AND life. Will Ananya and Kabir’s love survive when they find themselves on opposite sides of the debate on ethics? Passion for news brought them together. Will their ambitions tear them apart?

videos.title: Ananyas Breaking News
videos.overview: Will Ananya and Kabir’s love survive when they find themselves on opposite sides of the debate on ethics?

videos.title: Kabirs Exclusive Interview With Politician Pannalal
Ananya Plans to Do Sting Operation in KKN
Kabir Dejects the Idea of Celebration
Kabir Denies From Taking Back His Statement on Dr. Sinhas Case
Kabir Gets Locked in the Morgue Room
Ananya Convinces Neha to Confront the Truth
Malvika Is Flabbergasted Looking at the Questionnaire
Ananya Informs Kabir About the Lead in Mahi's Case
Kabir Helps Release Ananyas Brother From Jail
Ananya's Question to Kabir
videos.overview: Ananya along with Manav, is ready to interview the Bagi without informing her family. When stinger Pandey injects the fear of being killed into Manav’s mind, he backs out, and Rony puts Kabir into the scenario. The chemistry between Kabir and Ananya is still soar, however, Ananya allows Kabir to accompany her for the interview.

videos.title: Baby's Entry Into KKN
videos.overview: Kabir and Ananya are being followed and tracked by Baghi’s people on their way to the interview. His aides confiscates their camera and mobile phones before they meet Baghi. Baghi is suspicious about Ananya and the famous reporter Kabir accompanying her.

videos.title: Threat to Attack KKN
videos.overview: The interview begins, Baghi doesn't want the movie to release, and blames the system for what he is today. Everyone at the studio is worried as they haven't heard from Kabir or Ananya. Further, Baghi captivates both reporters and asks for a ransom from the government.

videos.title: Ananya Ka Sting Operation
videos.overview: Kabir plays the situation cool, on the contrary, Ananya spills the bean by her aggresive nature. Kabir explains her being calm is the only escape tactic they have, to keep away from Baghi's crosshair. KKN broadcasts the kidnapping of both their reporters leaving Ananya's family devastated.

videos.title: Kabir as Bhadresh Kutty
videos.overview: Baghi states his reason of being a dacoit, and reveals that he is doing all these to bring a massive change in the society.Shattered by the news, Ananya's mother and her brother reaches KKN office and is consoled by the staff. Police start their work and locate Baghi's hideout where Kabir and Ananya have been held hostage, however they manage to escape form the spot.

videos.title: Junior Reporter Ka Khulasa
videos.overview: Kabir Sharma and Ananya Kashyap are being taken deeper into the jungles, Ananya Kashyap realizes that her locket has gone missing. Although, Kabir explains to her that he has dropped the locket on purpose, Ananya runs back in order to get her locket. Madhav and other naxalites see this and Madhav is forced to shoot Ananya in order to stop her. Meanwhile, Ananya's mother is being convinced that she is alive as her locket has been found. At the same time, the media decides to launch a mass protest to ensure the safety of Kabir and Ananya. Will Ananya meet her end at the hands of Madhav? Keep watching to know more.

videos.title: Ananyas Chip
videos.overview: Kabir and Ananya try to untie themselves but their job is only half done as Madhav approaches them. Madhav informs them that the movie against him will be releasing in spite of all the warnings and decides to kill Kabir. Kabir, on the other hand, stands fearless and claims that Madhav is treading the wrong path and is trying to hide his crimes by prohibiting the movie from its release. Kabir by now, manages to untie himself completely and escapes Madhav's camp along with Ananya, with the help of Desu. But will Kabir and Ananya land in safe hands without any kind of hinderance from Madhav? Find out here.

videos.title: Ananya Wants an Apology
videos.overview: Madhav points his gun towards Kabir and Ananya who had earlier managed to escape from him. But before he takes his shot, inspector Khurana enters the picture and rescues the reporters. The naxalites are later, arrested and almost instantly, the news of Kabir Sharma and Ananya Kashyap being safe, reaches the employees of KKN news channel.The employees begin to celebrate and moments later, Kabir and Ananya join this celebrations. Later, Kabir decides to read the breaking news for the channel and asks Ananya to join him. What effect will Kabir and Ananya's news have on the viewers? FInd out here.

videos.title: Kabir Spills the Beans
videos.overview: Ananya's friends decide to have a party to celebrate her safe return and her mother too agrees to the party. Meanwhile, Malvika and Khalid invite Kabir to go out for dinner but Kabir decides to spend the night alone. Kabir later, turns down Ananya's invitation to the party too. Later, Ananya narrates all that had taken place during her encounter with the naxalites, to her friends, during the party. She later, hears about Kabir's divorce from her friends and gets upset. Keep watching to know more.

videos.title: Kabir Gets the Power
videos.overview: Ananya and Kabir spend some time messaging each other before going to sleep and next morning, the Ananya brings a box of sweet dish for Kabir. Kabir is more than pleased to see the tiffin box in her hand and agrees to have the dish. Later, Kabir has a meeting with his staff and just then, Ananya gets a call about a lead that has developed on the roads of Delhi. She takes Kabir's permission to shoot the incident for the news channel. She ends up surprised when she realizes that this lead is about Navdeep Mahajan who wants to commit suicide as he is love with a girl whom he has not even proposed yet. Will this situation make for a good news coverage? FInd out how Ananya deals with this case.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Ananya reaches the office and meets all of her colleagues who seems extremely happy with her news reporting skills. Kabir too signals her with his thumb raised upwards and Ananya is pleased to see him happy. But this makes Malvika jealous. Later, Rony reaches Ananya's home and decides to take her out for dinner. Ananya agrees, but she later refuses when Kabir calls her and expresses his desire to meet her. Kabir later enters her house and starts to tell her the truth regarding her father's death. Will Ananya learn the entire reality of her father death? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Ananya's mother arrives home and finds her daughter upset. On enquiring about the matter, Ananya produces the wallet that belonged to her father and reveals that her father is no more. Ananya's mother initially refuses to believe her daughter, but later bursts into tears. Meanwhile, Kabir seems upset as he has broken all of Ananya's hopes by informing her about her father's death. Later, in the office too, Kabir seems preoccupied by thoughts of Ananya. Rony later learns of Ananya's plight and immediately goes to his boss, Malvika, with a request to take a half day leave. When Malvika refuses to give him the leave, he decides to resign from the office, but Malvika stops him and gives him the leave. Will Kabir Sharma too reach Ananya's house in order to console her? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Malvika and Khalid start to get worried about Kabir, who has not turned up to the office, although it is almost time for him to read the news. But fortunately, Kabir arrives on time, and reads the news. He interviews, Navdeep and Jyoti, the two young lovers who had made headlines a few days earlier. While interviewing them, he refers to Jyoti as Ananya and the entire staff is shocked to see Kabir going wrong. Later, Manav tries to create a scene and accuses Kabir of being drunk while reading the news. However, the entire staff do not support his accusations. Keep watching to know what happens next.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Kabir is admitted to the hospital. The doctor sees his reports and declares him out of danger. Khalid comes over there and talks to the physician about Kabir’s health. Khalid mocks at Kabir’s condition and asks Kabir why he is becoming the old Kabir. Ananya enters into the office, where she get to know about the Kabir’s accident. She get worried and dials Kabir’s number. Richa comes to meet Kabir in the hospital where she ask Kabir to admit that he loves Ananya. Ananya tries to meet Kabir when she is about to leave the office, her boss come and stop her. Ananya tries to make her understand Will Ananya be able to meet Kabir.Keep watching to know what happens next.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Watch The Episode!

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Ananya learns that Kabir has left for Singapore and tries to find out about the reason behind his sudden departure out of the country. However, she does not get a proper answer to her questions and she is left tensed. Meanwhile, Manav speaks to Malvika and offers her to join his team against Kabir but Malvika refuses his offer. Later, Manav heads a meeting where he distributes work to the staff. Malvika later, relieves Ananya of the interview that she was supposed to conduct of Syal. She later adds that it is Kabir's order to have her relieved. Ananya once again is confused and starts to think about her relations with Kabir. Manav, on the other hand, starts forming a team of his own, in order to, take the position that Kabir currently holds. Will Manav succeed in his cunning intentions? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Rony finally develops enough courage and proposes his love to Ananya but Ananya gives him no answer. Later, Ananya discusses about Rony with her mother and friend and all ask her to accept Rony's proposal as he is the right guy for her. Ananya however, refuses to accept his proposal as Rony is only her friend and she has no feelings for him. Later, Rony enters Manav's room for some work purpose and Manav starts to discuss about Ananya and Kabir with him. Will Ananya accept or reject Rony's proposal? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Manav appreciates Richa as she reads the news and later offers her to read a special business news too. Ananya, on the other hand, continues to remain troubled about Kabir and she goes to his office and speaks to his chair. She starts to accuse him of breaking people's heart and treating relationship as a means for entertainment. Ananya however, is shocked when Kabir appears before her. Later, Kabir spends the night thinking about Ananya, while Ananya spends the night laying in her room. Will Kabir and Ananya make any efforts to take their relationship forward? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Rony reads the letter written by Ananya for him, which explains that she wants him to be her best friend and shares no other feelings for him, unlike him. Later, Ananya enters Kabir's room, in order to speak to him, but then, Malvika too enters the office and begins to speak about the previous night that she had spent with Kabir. This obviously gets Ananya jealous and she walks out, upset. Later, Kabir has a meeting with the senior staff but during this meeting, he ignores every question put forward by Ananya and instead answers the questions laid out by the others. Will Ananya succeed in solving the various problems that her life has put forward for her? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Ananya stands shocked when Kabir stands before her and asks her out for dinner. But Ananya feels bad when she realizes that Kabir was speaking to Malvika and not her. Later, Ananya speaks to her mother about the complications that her life is pouring upon her. Next day, Khalid informs Kabir of author Nalini Verma's arrival to India and Kabir suggests Ananya's name to handle the book launch event. Ananya meanwhile, speaks to Richa and expresses her wish to leave KKN news due to the problems in her life. Richa, on the other hand, advices her to concentrate on her work and not let anything else take priority in her life. Will Ananya succeed in escaping the complications of life? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: While, Ananya meets Nalini and brings her to KKN office, Kabir spends time with Anurag and pampers him until a new maid named Priyanka arrives. Later, Kabir meets Nalini and she informs Kabir about the pain that she notices in Ananya's eyes. After a while, Kabir has a meeting with his staff where he distributes the responsibilities among them. Just then, he gets a call from Anurag, who makes a demand for 'baigan ka bharta'. Having no idea about the dish, he asks his staff for the recipe. When Kabir asks Ananya for the recipe, she speaks rudely and refuses to indulge in any activity not concerning her job. Will Kabir have to meet Anurag's demands himself? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Anurag is pleased to see Ananya with a lunch box that contains his favorite dish, 'baigan ka bharta' in it. Anurag later, persuades Kabir to prepare coffee for Ananya while he  spends time with her. Later, Ananya leaves Kabir's house and Kabir goes on to narrate a romantic tale to Anurag that has Ananya in it. Next day at office, Ananya meets Nalini whom she is supposed to interview. A while later, Manav enters Rony's office and tries to convince him to sign on the papers that will help him replace Kabir. But Rony refuses to sign the papers. Watch the entire episode to witness the conversation between Nalini and Ananya.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Nalini speaks to Ananya about love and advices her to invest as less as possible on emotions such as love. Later, Ananya learns that Rony has decided to leave the job, in order to stay away from her and this upsets Ananya. Malvika, on the other hand, makes a plan to get rid of Ananya who is a hinderance in her relationship with Kabir. As per Malvika's plan, Ananya gets an attractive job offer from a competing news channel. Later, Kabir is forced to replace Ananya and takes Nalini's interview. But this interview turns out to be a nightmare for the author. Find out how? Will Kabir let Ananya leave KKN office? Keep watching to get your answers.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Kabir's interview with Nalini continues and he calls her act of, not trusting her lover, an act of haste. He later, brings Nalini's lover, Shekhar and Nalini is shocked to learn that Shekhar had lost his legs. Shekhar had decided to leave Nalini as he did not want to be a burden to her. Nalini realizes her mistake and repents as she apologizes to Shekhar. After the interview concludes, Ananya leaves the office and Malvika seems happy. Richa and Trisha later, are astonished at the news of her resignation and decide to do something about it. Will Trisha and Richa succeed in stopping Ananya from leaving the KKN office? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Ananya's mother is not very happy about her daughter transferring to Mumbai but Ananya insists on leaving Delhi for better job prospects. Later, Ananya's colleagues from the office, meet her and try to convince her to not leave KKN office but Ananya sticks to her decision. Next day, Ananya reaches her office before leaving for Mumbai, in order to meet her friends for the last time. But she is surprised, when she finds the entire office empty. Her surprise turns into shock when she finds Kabir waiting for her at the office. Will Kabir stop Ananya from leaving KKN office? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Kabir has confessed about his feeling to Ananya. Ananya has accepted Kabir’s proposal. Kabir was supposed to deliver a speech but he was missing. Manav informs Malvika that Kabir is busy in something more important than delivering a speech, and has said him to deliver the speech on his behalf. Meanwhile Kabir and Ananya are busy romancing and expressing their feeling for each other. Kabir insists her to maintain the relation between an Editor-in-Chief to that of a Junior reporter. Watch full episode to know more about Kabir and Ananya’s new relation.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Kabir gets angry with Ananya when she enters the meeting room, in between his conference, to secretly express his intense love for him. He tries to explain to her that she needs to maintain the decorum of the office, but Ananya is too excited in love to listen to what Kabir is trying to explain. Later, it is time for Trisha to read her last piece of news at KKC news channel as she will now be leaving the channel to start a new life. Trisha gets emotional when she bids her collegues farewell. Kabir too is overcome by emotion and he suddenly declares dinner from his side to the entire office. Everyone in the office, including Malvika senses something fishy about Kabir's current behaviour. Keep watching to know what happens next.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Kabir is surprised to know that Ananya has not yet informed Rony about their relationship and he feels that she is doing wrong by hiding facts from her best friend. Later, int he office, Malvika calls Ananya to her office and speaks to her about her relationship with Kabir. She tries to threaten her by saying that she has broken various laws of the office, but Ananya seems fearless and accuses her of maintaining relationship with Manav, who is an office employee too. Will Ananya finally inform Rony about her relationship with Kabir? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Kabir is KKN studios and was anchoring on a Breaking news. In the meantime during the breaks Ananya came inside the PCR room and expressed her love to Kabir. Everyone present in the Newsroom got shocked by the way Ananya expressed her love. Will Kabir get annoyed with Ananya’s behavior? What will Malvika do after knowing about Kabir’s affair? To know all keep watching full episode.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Malvika makes a call and informs about an urgent requirement in the office for the post of a junior reporter. Later, Kabir has a meeting with the staff and introduces them to Baby, the new reporter in the channel. However, the young, bubbly Baby ends up creating trouble for Manav on her first day in the office. Later, Ananya enters Kabir's cabin and is surprised to hear him express his love for her. Meanwhile, Manav meets Richa and informs her about the reality of Brij Mohan, the minister she will be interviewing a while later. Will Richa's interview of Brij Mohan end up creating problems for her? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Richa has asked some bold and an uncomfortable questions to a minister after which minister’s party members and supporters has beaten up Sunny and has threaten Richa with dare consequences. They are now demanding Richa’s resignation. In the meantime, Kabir get to know that supporters of the minister are planning to attack on a KKN News. However, it was Manav who has asked Richa to ask that particular question to the minister. Will Manav take up the responsibility? What will happen to KKN News? To know all keep watching full episode.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Kabir has got secret information about Member of Parliament Brijmohan’s illegal properties in India and aboard. Brijmohan’s supporters have earlier threaten to attack on KKN channel and has demanded Richa’s resignation. However, the editor-in-chief has decided to air the information on their news channel. On the other hand Ananya is trying to conduct a dangerous sting operation. The sting operation is very risky! Will Kabir allow Ananya to go ahead with the sting operation? To know all keep watching full episode.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Ananya was very eager to conduct a sting operation on illegal arms dealer Shikandar. However, Kabir didn’t want to risk Ananya’s life so he made a plan along with Tony. The plan was to introduce Kabir as Bhadresh Kutty, as an arms supplier of South India. Both Ananya and Bhadresh then went on to meet Shikandar in his den and to conduct the dangerous sting operation. Will Ananya know the actual identity of Bhadresh Kutty? Can Ananya succeed in exposing the arm’s dealer on her News Channel? To know all keep watching full episode.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: The sting operation was successfully conducted by Ananya and it is going to be aired on KKN. In the meantime, Kabir is getting ready for his next programme where he will be exposing the illegal arms dealer on his news channel. Just before the important programme the sting operation footage which was stored in a chip goes missing. Now, how will the sting operation be aired on KKN news channel? What will happen to the reputation of KKN news channel? To know all keep watching full episode.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Ananya pleads with Malvika to let Inspector Khurana's telephonic call go live and Malvika finally agrees. After completing the news session, Kabir goes straight to Ananya and shouts at her for having put the reputation of the news channel in danger by not providing the chip that had the proof to support her sting operation. Ananya and her colleagues however, are certain that Ananya's chip has been stolen by Malvika. Ananya later goes to Malvika's cabin and asks her for the chip but Malvika refuses to have any knowledge of it. Malvika later, throws the chip into the dustbin but a while later, she hides it in her drawer instead. Later, Kabir drives Ananya home but the two of them get into an argument on the way. Keep watching to know more.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Ananya and Kabir's cold war continues and this cold war carries on even during the meeting that is presided by Kabir. As Kabir goes on to distribute responsibilities, Malvika observes that something is wrong between Kabir and Ananya. Later, Ananya discusses with Rony about her fight with Kabir and adds that she wants Kabir to apologize to him. Just then, Manav reaches the scene and tries to instigate Ananya to act against Kabir but ends up feeling insulted by her. A while later, Richa and Rony discuss about Ananya and Richa expresses her worries regarding Ananya. Will Kabir finally apologize to Ananya and bring an end to this cold war? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Kabir soon understands the real reason behind Ananya's weird behavior and he plans to make up to her. He goes to Ananya's house to meet her and seeing him there, Ananya is surprised. Later, Ananya's mother senses something going on between the two of them and asks Ananya about it. Before Ananya says anything, Kabir informs her mother about their relationship but Ananya's mother does not seem happy about this relationship. Meanwhile, Malvika and Manav team up together and ploy a cunning plan to get Kabir out of the News channel. Keep watching to know what happens next.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Kabir meets Ananya's mother and the two of them speak about Kabir and Ananya's relationship. After speaking to Ananya's mother for a while, Kabir manages to convince her to accept this relationship. Kabir later reaches the office and informs Ananya that her mother has accepted their relationship. Ananya gets excited and hugs Kabir. Manav sees the intimacy that Kabir and Ananya share in the office but the two of them are shocked to see Manav in the office. Meanwhile, Richa does not seem to be happy with this relationship as she believes that Kabir is using Ananya but Rony does not agree with her. Will Kabir prove Richa wrong, now that he is being induced with more power? Find out more.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Malvika tries to convince Kabir to accept the proposal offered to him but Kabir continues to stick to his stand. A while later, Ananya enters the office and takes Kabir's permission to go home early. Later that evening, Kabir arrives at Ananya's home while she gets ready for her date with Kabir. Kabir and Ananya visit a restaurant where Kabir proves Ananaya, who is under the belief that Kabir not a romantic person like her, wrong. The two of them however, remain uncertain regarding the fact that Kabir's first wife has just made her entry into the KKN office.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Kabir signs the contract papers that make him a shareholder of KKN and also bind him to the company for three years. Meanwhile, Ananya is unable to keep the information to herself and she informs Rony about Kabir's new designation. Kabir however, is shocked when he realizes that he had been lured into signing the papers so that he will not be leaving the company after he learns of Shreya's re-entry into KKN as the new business head. Ananya too is surprised when she learns of Shreya being Kabir's ex-wife but she asks Kabir to think of the situation from the business point of view. How will Shreya's entry into Kabir's life cause tremors in his relationship with Ananya? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Kabir gets furious with Khalid as he has been trapped by him to stay in KKN for another three years. Kabir later, goes straight to Shreya, with his resignation letter, but Shreya refuses his resignation as he is bound by the contract. Instead, she tries to make him realize what advantages the company and the two of them will be having due to her return. Kabir however, refuses to listen to Shreya and submits his resignation. He does not care about the legality of the contract and announces the resignation to the staff of KKN. How will Ananya react to the news of Kabir's resignation? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Richa tries to advice Ananya but Ananya shouts at her and asks her to stay away from her personal life. She later, goes to convince Kabir to rejoin in the company but Kabir scolds her and refuses to work at KKN. Later, Richa and Ananya begin to behave like strangers in the office and the tension between the two is understood by everyone in the office. Kabir meanwhile, continues to believe that he has been fooled but his senior assures him that he is needed in the company and should act professionally. Keep watching to know more.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Shreya tries to bring in her past with Kabir and this gets him even more furious. Meanwhile, Malvika taunts Ananya by saying that she might have to look for a new job as Kabir's stay in the office seems uncertain. Later, Kabir enters Ananya's office and asks her to join him as he wants to discuss about a certain matter. But Ananya refuses to meet him. Kabir leaves the office, fuming with rage and later informs Tarini about Shreya's return. Tarani later, asks him to sought out his matter with Ananya and at the same time, Ananya is busy complaining of Kabir to Rony. Will Kabir finally agree to be a part of KKN? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Ananya speaks to Malvika and makes her realize that she will now have to be reporting to Shreya and will not be enjoying the benefits of being the superior senior. This hits Malvika hard but she realizes that this is the truth, when Khalid confirms what Ananya had said. Later, Shreya meets the staff of KKN one by one and goes on to promote Richa. The entire staff is happy to learn of Richa's promotion and later Ananya is asked to enter the office. Ananya ends up surprised when Shreya promotes her from the position of junior reporter to the post of senior reporter. Ananya however, is shocked when Kabir raises an objection to this promotion. Keep watching to know how Ananya will react to Kabir's shocking reaction.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Khalid is surprised with Ananya's decision of rejecting the promotion and he asks Richa and Rony for the possible reason behind Ananya's surprising decision. Richa and Rony act unaware and do not speak of Ananya's ongoing relationship with Kabir. Kabir meanwhile tries to speak to convince Ananya but Ananya seems to be in no mood to listen to him. Later, Richa hosts the new segment on the news channel, taking Manava's place and everyone is happy with her. Ananya too is happy for Richa friend but continues to maintain her distance from her. Keep watching to know what happens next.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Malvika understands that although Shreya is not ready to accept her love towards Kabir, she still has feelings for him. She decides to make use of certain photographs to create differences between Shreya and Kabir. Meanwhile, Kabir tries his best to contact Ananya but fails. He speaks to Ananya's brother and asks for his help, so that he can speak to Ananya, but her brother's plan too meets with failure. Next morning, Kabir takes Rony's help and manages to get a chance to speak to Ananya. Will Ananya finally listen to Kabir's side of the story? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Watch the full episode.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Everyone at KKN has now become aware about Ananya and Kabir’s relationship. Malvika on the other hand has conspired to tarnish Ananya’s reputation. However, Kabir knows about Malvika’s conspiracy but is unable to prove it before everyone. In the meantime, during Ananya and Kabir’s conversation, for the first time Kabir has openly spoke about Malvika’s hatred towards Ananya. What will Kabir do now? Will he warn Malvika to mind her business? To know all, keep watching full episode!

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Ananya and Richa have got promotion in KKN, Rony and Kabir has decided for a surprise party for them. It is a top secret that the party is in the cafeteria after office hours. Sunny and Rony have taken the responsibility to bring them down to the cafeteria for the surprise party. But what will happen when Ananya will meet Richa in the cafeteria? Will they become friends again? To know more, keep watching full episode!

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Kabir calls Richa to his office in order to speak to her personally. He tries his best to convince her that he does not intend to ruin her friendship with Ananya and instead wants their friendship to remain intact. He also adds that she and Rony are now his friends too along with being Ananya's close friends. As he continues to explain himself to Richa, he gets a call regarding a new piece of news. He sends Ananya to cover the story and later, Richa is asked to report the news of the story covered by Ananya. Will this association between Ananya and Richa bring the two of them close once again? Find out here.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Kabir and Ananya was discussing about Shreya’s character inside the green room, it was then she heard them talking and interrupted Kabir between their discussions. She said that Kabir is still carrying the handkerchief which she has gifted him years back. She pointed out that Kabir is still in love with her and has never forgotten her. Ananya who is now in a relationship with Kabir was feeling uncomfortable about something, she choose to leave them alone and came out of the green room. Was this Shreya’s trick to hurt Ananya? Does Kabir still loves Shreya? What is Ananya thinking right now? To know all, keep watching full episode!

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Shreya was feeling guilty about the whole thing which has happened inside the office and she thought to apologize for her behavior. She went to Ananya’s house to meet her personally and convey her apology to her. However, Ananya’s mother got little suspicious about Shreya meeting with Ananya in her house. She came to know about Shreya's past relationship with Kabir. Now, will Ananya’s mother get angry after knowing Shreya’s past? Will Kabir ever get to know that Shreya has met Ananya at her house? To know all, keep watching full episode!

videos.title: Episode 84
